model.team_goals: Expected goals per fixture = league average for the venue (1.55 home / 1.25 away) x attacking multiplier x opponent's defensive multiplier. Multipliers start from FPL's strength ratings and blend towards this season's observed xG (half weight after 6 matches).
model.clean_sheet: P(clean sheet) = exp(-opponent expected goals), i.e. Poisson zero.
model.player: P(goal) = 1 - exp(-lambda), lambda = xG per 90 (shrunk towards a positional prior over 270 minutes) x expected minutes / 90 x fixture factor. Expected minutes = average of the last 3 gameweeks x chance of playing. Assists use xA the same way.
model.xpts: Model xPts = appearance points + goal points x goal lambda + 3 x assist lambda + clean-sheet points x P(CS) - conceded penalty (GKP/DEF). No bonus, no saves, no cards.
